scope: Train on original train+val; public test single-trial top5 for checkpoint selection; public test score is NOT independent evaluation
split: Original train+val combined; original test reused only for model selection
initialization: fresh pretrained REVE; seed33; reference initialization order
baseline: B ProjectedHead; full-parameter training from pretrained REVE; original diagonal clean+blur loss; matched baseline arm
test_role: public test single Top5 model selection, not independent test
runtime: single CUDA process; v14 used one-rank DDP, no cross-rank loss changes
selection: stage1 pure global blur single_trial top5; stage2 clean single_trial top5; public test selection, not independent evaluation
weights: per subject; mean training repeats per image; fold-local StandardScaler/PCA, 5 folds, Ridge100; no test EEG
global_loss: original v33 clean+blur equal, single-direction image-normalized ClipLoss; only local loss uses multi-positive bidirectional contrast
experiment: v43 local OT stage1 from fresh pretrained REVE; stage2 freeze selected source and train fresh B recovery
